name: list_profiles
description: List the agent profiles you can dispatch to (id, runtime, model, status). With a session token only your own device's profiles are listed.

deviceId.description: Device to list; ignored for a session token.

name: create_session
description: Create a new Foundry session and deliver it a task. With a session token the new session is your child on your device and joins your orchestration group; without profileId and provider it runs like you. Returns once queued unless wait=true, which blocks until it settles and returns its response. Parallel sessions writing the same repository race: split independent work and keep one writer per target. Codex cannot steer an active turn (the message queues for the next turn).

prompt.description: The task brief for the new session.

verification.description: Run a read-only independent verifier (no Write/Edit/Bash); use for checking another session's work.

forkSessionId.description: Fork: resume another session's native transcript in a brand new thread.

issueId.description: Run inside that Issue's candidate worktree and sandbox (requires an active Issue run).

wait.description: Block until the session settles and return its response.

name: list_sessions
description: List sessions in this workspace (id, title, status, parentSessionId). Use it to see what exists before creating or acting.

name: list_group_sessions
description: List every session in one orchestration group, in list order. A replacement orchestrator uses this to take over a group without lineage transfer.

name: get_session
description: Get one session's current summary (status, title, lineage).

name: read_context
description: Read another session's context. scope=summary (default, cheap), thread (all turns of the conversation) or transcript (raw native chat). Output is tail-truncated by maxBytes to protect your context window.

name: steer_session
description: Send an additional instruction to a running session you created. It adjusts the active turn (Claude) or queues for the next turn (Codex).

name: cancel_session
description: Stop a running or queued session you created. Cancelling never cascades: sessions it created keep running as independent sessions.

name: wait_session
description: Block until a session reaches one of the requested statuses (default: completed/failed/canceled) or the timeout elapses, and return it with its response once settled. Prefer this over polling loops.

name: rename_session
description: Rename a session you created (1-120 characters).
